about: Controls for lane L64's review of issues 927-931, with each expected outcome stated before any control ran. Applied to each of the five certificates. 'Past' is 1e-30 beyond exact contact. 'Both' means methods A (separating axes, Fraction) and B (clipped areas, mpq) of the frozen checker, deciding the whole file unless the control says pair-level or square-level. S is the certificate's side; i, j is its least-margin pair from check-nNNN.json, j the second id.
stated: 2026-11-09, before l64_controls.py was written or run
